title: Megurine Luka — Surprise Challenger〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Street SEKAI
Crase Cafe

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Okay, I think we're all done setting up the victory party we've been planning for Akito and the others.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Yeah! And the food looks great!
And I even got that thing ready!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm really looking forward to that. Anyway, Len, can you take care of things in the kitchen?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yup!
se_walk_men_004_1

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Then...Rin, KAITO.
Mind carrying the food over for me?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
You got it!
I'll take the drinks too while I'm at it!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Wait, all at once?!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Easy-peasy♪
Don't be such a worrywart, KAITO.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Be careful!
Watch out for the chairs!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
I said I'm fine!
I'll just whoosh right over!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Hehe.
Everyone sounds so excited.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: We're celebrating Akito and the others making their big return! Of course we're all excited!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Akito went out there all by himself, put on a performance that shook the city and got everyone to believe in his team again. Throwing a party is the least we can do♪

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh, speak of the devil...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: We're here!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Welcome, everyone!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Ah, there's our hero!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I think she's talking about you, Akito.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Me? The hero...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Hehe. But you are the hero, Akito.
You ignited everyone all by yourself!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Come to think of it, I guess we should be celebrating your success instead of being celebrated, you know...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
I see what you mean.
Let's help get everything set up.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Yeah, let's!
MEIKO, is there anything you need help with?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Oh, that's so kind of you to offer.
Then, would you mind giving Len a hand in the kitchen?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: He's making the pièce de résistance for us, but I'm sure he'll appreciate all the help he can get.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
The pièce de résistance...?
That sounds like fun! Let's go!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe. Thank you three very much.
se_walk_women_004_1
se_walk_women_004_1

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Then I'll...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Sit right here and make yourself at home! I hope you're looking forward to seeing Len's creation.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
O-Okay...
Got it...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Oh, can you tell us what happened during your performance? We heard that you put on quite a show!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah, it sounded like you blew everyone away all by yourself!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Hehe. That's our Akito!
I knew he'd come through.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Why are you saying that as if you're bragging...?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Oh, would you like to know?!
The thing is...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I'm the one who told Akito that he needed to let all his feelings out. Me. Yours truly.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Wait, really?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: It's not as cool when you say it yourself...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Isn't that the truth...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Still, that's amazing!
How did you get him to do that exactly?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
The two of us sang one on one!
I thought it'd be easier to do that instead of just explaining what to do to him.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: One on one... So, you had a battle?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
A battle?
No, not exactly...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Fine, then let's make it a battle!
That should be more enticing, no?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
That's just how I do things!
Oh, would you all mind acting as the judges?

rows.Speaker: Luka & MEIKO
rows.Line:
Oh.
Yeah.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
That's right!
I did call it a battle, didn't I?!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: But you ended it partway through. You yelled out, “Stop!”

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Wait, why?!
Wasn't that supposed to be his big moment?!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: No, I think what she did was right.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: MEIKO...!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: See?! It isn't about winning or losing petty battles! We have much more important things to worry about!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Right...
And you did help me make an incredibly important realization, Luka.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Again, thank you.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Still, Akito, you've grown a lot since then, right?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Are you sure that you can still beat him, Luka?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Me? Yes, I can still...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Actually, she may have a point.
After all, they do always keep finding new ways to surprise us with their growth.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: No, Miku, don't say that...!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: A-Alright, fine! If you're all going to gang up on me like that, let's have a rematch, Akito!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: But you just said...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Ahaha...
se_walk_men_004_1
se_walk_women_004_1

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Hey, MEIKO!
We're set to go!!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Akito! You're not gonna believe what you're about to see!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Ta-daa! Today's main dish is...
Ginormous pancakes!!!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Whoa! What the...?!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: They're bigger than our faces!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Let's have these before our battle, Akito!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Agreed.
We'll need to work as a team to get through them.
